topic: being the strong one for everyone
lines: He always agrees to every extra plan.
She schedules a weekend trip, he grabs his bag.
He’s exhausted, work is stacking, yet he forces a smile.
He worries love will disappear if he says no.
People say yes just to keep others from leaving.
Saying no doesn’t mean love will vanish.
Protecting your time actually protects you.
Follow for more daily life changing videos.
cta: Follow for more daily life changing videos.
caption: Saying no isn’t selfish—it’s self-preserving. Share with someone who needs this.
